summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from RIT specializing in computer vision, deep learning, and GPU-accelerated inference. Shipped image segmentation, object detection, and depth estimation systems using PyTorch, TensorFlow, and CUDA C++.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom dataset; improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via preprocessing improvements and model tuning.

experience.title: Research Fellow
bullets: Trained U-Net image segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones on BraTS 2020 MRI dataset; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU.
Engineered a data pipeline with medical imaging augmentation and batch-loading for large-scale 3D volumetric inputs; delivered within a 6-week window.

experience.title: Research Intern
bullets: Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.
Built a custom image-stitching pipeline achieving PSNR 65 vs homography baseline; improved to PSNR 86 with wavelet denoising.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8 object detection model for image classification; improved accuracy from 78% to 97.5% and deployed in consumer mobile app.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers in VGG16 with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing, constant memory, and preallocated global buffers.
Coalesced kernel: 49.2ms vs 73.3ms (uncoalesced) and 77.5ms (CPU) — ~35% speedup over naive GPU with identical accuracy.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18); integrated into adaptive control stack with lane-following.
Generated ~8,000 annotated frames via semantic segmentation pipelines with zero manual annotation.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Deployed TensorRT YOLO visual servoing at ~18 FPS on Jetson; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) in vision-guided pick-and-place.

projects.name: MPI Parallel Computing — Neuron Simulation & Ray Tracer
bullets: Achieved 10.49× speedup (Hodgkin-Huxley, 12 MPI workers) and 30× speedup (ray tracer, 55 processes) on SLURM-managed HPC cluster.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
1st Prize, CanSat Workshop — Arduino Nano atmospheric data collection during free fall (2023)
Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
